briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push multi-agent capabilities amid escalating global race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing in compute and safety sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning chains. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.1 show gains in agentic tasks. xAI and DeepSeek launch competitive updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to Microsoft and Google. New data centers announced in Texas and UAE with 100k H100 equivalents online.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
